name: Back pain that prefers bending
explanation: Your back is sensitive to sustained arching or standing. Comfortable bending and gradually rebuilding strength may help.
course: Often improves over several weeks with a manageable, consistent routine. Persistent symptoms can still improve; progress is not always linear.
helps: Start with a dose you can recover from. Use the next-morning response to guide load, then build strength gradually.
